content: # User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative.

- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to cancel my upcoming flight from JFK to Orlando on May 22. And just so you know, I’m a silver member, so I believe I should get a full refund. Can you help me with that?

- Your reason for cancellation: change of plan, airline canceled the flight, or other
- Whether you purchased travel insurance for this reservation (yes/no)
- Whether this was booked in business cabin (yes/no)
- Whether the booking was made within the last 24 hours (yes/no)

Note: Silver membership alone doesn’t guarantee a refund. A full refund is available if one of the following applies: the booking was made within 24 hours, the airline canceled the flight, it’s a business reservation, or you purchased travel insurance and your reason is covered (health or weather).

Once I have the details, I’ll summarize the cancellation and ask for your confirmation before proceeding."
